name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1, fueled by watching Ayrton Senna dominate the tracks. After graduating from the University of Lisbon with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he specialized in composite materials, landing his first job at a small aerospace firm. He honed his skills there for several years before transitioning to motorsport, joining a smaller GT team initially.

His meticulous nature and innovative problem-solving abilities quickly made him an invaluable asset. Ricardo thrives on the challenge of constantly pushing the boundaries of performance through material science and design. At Walkenhorst Motorsport, he's known for his relentless pursuit of weight reduction and improved aerodynamic efficiency, always seeking that crucial tenth of a second. He is particularly skilled with carbon fibre repair and fabrication.

Ricardo’s approach is characterized by his commitment to teamwork, constantly collaborating with engineers and drivers to translate their needs into tangible improvements. He always brings a 'can-do' attitude, and his ability to think outside the box has led to some truly innovative solutions to complex problems, making him a highly valued member of the Walkenhorst team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a wiry build, suggesting a life of physical activity.
